query_contract.algorithm: nearest source cell by great-circle distance

out_of_support.required_behavior: error; do not extrapolate and do not treat as zero or neutral current

query_contract.admission_rule: Only admissible_conditional_likelihood families may update the integrated estimator.

families.label: Native HYCOM currents + distinct WAVERYS Stokes
conditions: full WAVERYS surface Stokes drift kept distinct from direct wind response
flaperon response is Stokes plus 0.10 m/s at 20 degrees left of wind
isotope is a bounded arrival-conditional compatibility screen
limitations: the retained native-current field ends on 2015-07-29; upstream experiment 53.X ends in December 2015, so even an extension cannot represent the 2016 recoveries or Australian non-recovery interval
the retained current series is every eighth available three-hour analysis with explicit repaired gaps, not a daily mean
HYCOM+NCODA is assimilative, so the drifter replay is not guaranteed statistically held out
the coast field distinguishes land from missing water but does not calibrate beach retention

families.label: GDP monthly climatology + distinct WAVERYS Stokes
conditions: GDP currents are a separate observational monthly-climatology family
nine selected recovery episodes use explicit stochastic beaching-to-discovery delays
two Australian non-recovery populations bracket low-exposure and hypothetical high-windage response without sharing recovered-object identities
isotope is a bounded arrival-conditional compatibility screen
limitations: the preserved GDP regional extract has sparse finite coverage and is 0.5 degree rather than the current official 0.25-degree product
monthly climatology omits interannual current variability over 2014-2017
the GDP product and validation drifters are not statistically independent
no subjective weight combines GDP with an assimilative current family
